context: Two friends discuss a zoo and food
purpose: Teach: キリン/ハチ/蜂蜜/前菜/スイーツ/ガッツ/菜の花/リーフ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 動物園、キリンの首、すごく長いよね。
lines.en: Zoo giraffes have such long necks, don't they?
lines.style: Light, immediate wonder. Voice lifts at the observation. Genuine delight — not performing, just noticing something beautiful and wanting to share it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。庭の花、ハチが集まってる。
lines.en: Yeah. I saw bees all over the garden flowers this morning.
lines.style: Gentle agreement. Unhurried pace. Soft focus — remembering a quiet moment. Comfortable silence between the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 蜂蜜入りの紅茶、私の好物。
lines.en: I love honey in my tea — it's one of my favorite things.
lines.style: Open, almost vulnerable in the admission. Warm smile underneath. Slight emphasis on 'favorite' — letting her care show without making it theatrical.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: コース料理の前菜、ボリュームあって嬉しい。
lines.en: The starter portion was so generous — I was really happy about that.
lines.style: Pleased, straightforward. A light laugh underneath. No irony. Just genuine appreciation for small kindnesses.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: デザートのスイーツ、今日は控えめにする。
lines.en: I think I'll go easy on dessert today.
lines.style: Quieter shift. Thoughtful, almost gentle with herself. A pause before speaking — considering, not indecisive. Tender self-awareness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 最後まで、ガッツで完食する派よ。
lines.en: Me? I'm the type to finish everything — no matter what.
lines.style: Dry humor with warmth underneath. Slight self-deprecation. Light, knowing smile in the voice. A playful jab at herself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 菜の花の煮物、春らしくて好きなの。
lines.en: Spring greens in that stew — there's something about it I really love.
lines.style: Tender nostalgia. Voice softens on the memory. Slow, savoring pace. Like she's reaching back for something seasonal and kind.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 紅茶のリーフ、新茶、入荷した?
lines.en: Did the new tea leaves come in? The spring harvest?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, leaning forward slightly. Warm interest in something she cares about. An invitation — asking something that matters to her.
